en_title: Phantom Blade Zero Looks Like a Hit Before It's Even Come Out, With an Estimated 1 Million Prelaunch Copies Sold
cn_title: 《影之刃零》预售量估计已破百万
subtitle: 未发售，先热卖
opus_summary: 市场分析师估计，《影之刃零》发售前销量已超百万份，其中近三分之二来自中国大陆、台湾和香港。分析师认为，本作销量不太可能达到《黑神话：悟空》的高度。

paragraphs.en: Phantom Blade Zero is on track to be a huge hit, with estimates suggesting the action game has already sold over 1 million copies before launch.
paragraphs.cn: 《影之刃零》有望大获成功。据估计，这款动作游戏尚未发售，销量就已超过100万份。

paragraphs.en: In a post on social media , Rhys Elliott, head of market analysis at Alinea Analytics , estimated that Phantom Blade Zero had sold 850,000 pre-launch copies on Western launch platforms Steam and PS5, with sales on Tencent’s WeGame (an online PC storefront in China) bumping the total figure above 1 million.
paragraphs.cn: Alinea Analytics市场分析负责人Rhys Elliott在社交媒体发文估计，《影之刃零》发售前在西方市场首发平台Steam和PS5上的销量已达85万份。加上腾讯旗下WeGame（中国的PC游戏线上商店）的销量，总销量已超过100万份。

paragraphs.en: Of the Western launch prelaunch sales, Elliott estimated three quarters were on Steam. Nearly two thirds of total prelaunch sales are from China, Taiwan, or Hong Kong. Phantom Blade Zero is a wuxia action game developed by Chinese studio S-Game, and features martial arts movie star Donnie Yen.
paragraphs.cn: Elliott估计，在上述西方市场首发平台的预售销量中，Steam占四分之三。全部预售销量中，近三分之二来自中国大陆、台湾和香港。《影之刃零》由中国工作室S-Game开发，是一款武侠动作游戏，功夫影星甄子丹也参与其中。

paragraphs.en: Elliott said that Phantom Blade Zero's prelaunch sales had generated $43 million in revenue, and had cracked the top 40 games of 2026 by revenue before it’s even released, despite only being available on PC and PS5. He did, however, add that Phantom Blade Zero is unlikely to hit the sales heights of 2024's megahit, Black Myth Wukong, but still, "it'll sell a lot of copies this year in a crowded market."
paragraphs.cn: Elliott表示，《影之刃零》的预售收入已达4,300万美元(约合人民币3亿元)（人民币约合金额暂无法核实）。尽管仅登陆PC和PS5，本作尚未发售就已跻身2026年游戏收入榜前40名。不过，他也补充说，《影之刃零》的销量不太可能达到2024年现象级热门作品《黑神话：悟空》的高度，但「它今年仍会在竞争激烈的市场中卖出大量份数」。

paragraphs.en: For context, Game Science's Black Myth Wukong sold an eye-watering 10 million copies in the first three days alone, and has reportedly sold over 20 million copies to date. Unsurprisingly, a follow-up is in development.
paragraphs.cn: 作为参照，游戏科学的《黑神话：悟空》仅在发售头三天就卖出了惊人的1,000万份，据报道，迄今销量已超过2,000万份。不出所料，后续作品正在开发中。

paragraphs.en: IGN’s 9/10 Phantom Blade review called it “an unbelievably smooth action game filled with memorable boss fights, compelling combat, and limitless swagger.”
paragraphs.cn: IGN为《影之刃零》打出了9分（满分10分），评测称其为「一款流畅得令人难以置信的动作游戏，有令人难忘的Boss战、引人入胜的战斗，以及无处不在的潇洒风范」。

paragraphs.en: If you’re wondering when you can start swinging, check out our Phantom Blade Zero global release times and preload details post . There’s a full breakdown for exactly when you can fire it up for major cities around the world.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你想知道什么时候能开始挥刀战斗，可以查看我们关于《影之刃零》全球解锁时间及预载详情的文章。其中详细列出了全球主要城市的具体解锁时间。

paragraphs.en: Phantom Blade Zero looks set to be one of the biggest video games of October 2026 , rubbing shoulders with the likes of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, and Final Fantasy Resonance. 2026 is shaping up to be a special year, with the Ocarina of Time remake and GTA 6 still to come.
paragraphs.cn: 《影之刃零》看起来有望成为2026年10月最重磅的游戏之一，与《使命召唤：现代战争4》《任天堂 Switch运动 Resort》和《Final Fantasy Resonance》等作品并列。2026年有望成为不平凡的一年，《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版和《GTA6》也仍待登场。
